component.name: System Assistant
component.summary: System maintenance and post-install setup utility

description.p: A native GTK 4 and Libadwaita utility to update system packages and Flatpaks, mute the hardware PC speaker module, and install essential desktop tools.

screenshot.caption: Main window showing system maintenance toggles

description.p: Organized interface into dedicated tabs and added GNOME post-install tweaks:

ul.li: Added Overview, Maintenance, and Tweaks & Apps navigation tabs
Added native About window with developer info
Added RPM Fusion & multimedia codec setup, adw-gtk3 theme, and window titlebar button toggles

description.p: Added System Hardware summary card and storage cleanup tasks:

ul.li: Expandable System Hardware summary card (device, CPU, RAM, GPU)
Clear package manager cache and vacuum old systemd journal logs
